title: Brazilian Roasted Runner Bean Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole featuring roasted runner beans in a Brazilian-inspired flair.
instructions: Toss the runner beans with olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the runner beans in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until softened.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the roasted runner beans, cooked onion and garlic mixture, and Brazilian cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
